set.body:
Implement the planned parallel execution surface without changing deterministic results by default.

Contracts: ExecutionControl remains default-off; enabling parallelFrames preserves trace/diagnostic equality within stated floating tolerances; nThreads is validated; shared code does not acquire JVM-only concurrency dependencies.

Deliverables: deterministic frame scheduling, tests comparing sequential and parallel outputs on synthetic runs, and performance guardrails for representative frame counts.

Acceptance: default execution is byte/diagnostic-compatible with current behavior; enabled parallel mode is covered on JVM and either supported or explicitly typed-off on Scala.js; no hidden nondeterminism in tests.
set.title: Add deterministic parallel frame execution for motion estimator
